title: Current Account - declaration of existing credit facilities
text: I understand that as per extant Reserve Bank of India guidelines, opening of any current account requires declaration of existing credit facilities with any of the Bank's branches or any other bank. I shall declare details of any such Credit facilities enjoyed with any Bank in the Account Opening Form, as per the required format therein. I undertake to obtain the requisite No Objection Certificate/s from such Bank/s and hand it/them over to you before the account gets opened.

title: Current Account - repayment of overdrafts on demand
text: I agree to repay to the Bank on demand, unconditionally, the amounts of overdrafts that the Bank may grant to me from time to time, together with interest accrued thereon. I agree that this does not imply that the Bank is bound to grant me any credit facility whatsoever.

title: Current Account - digital opening address verification
text: I/we understand that, upon opening account digitally, bank will verify the mailing address registered at the time of opening of account and in case same is found to be negative, account will be Blocked/Closed centrally without any further notice to me/us.

title: Current Account - VCIP rejection and fund return
text: I/we understand that, in case of VCIP rejection, account will be closed centrally and funds if any would be sent via Demand Draft on registered mailing address and the Bank shall not be held liable towards any claims, damages on account of such closure of the account.

title: Current Account - virtual asset / cryptocurrency related entities not permitted
text: HDFC Bank does not permit opening of accounts of entities engaged/involved/dealing in transactions related to virtual assets (including but not limited to cryptocurrency trading, exchanges, or any other related activities). If an account is found to be in violation of this policy at any time, the Bank reserves the right to block or close the account without giving any prior notice. The Bank shall not be liable for any loss, claims, or damages arising from blocking/closing of such account.

title: Biz Current Account - free first-year Business Insurance and Payment Protection Cover
text: I/We understand that Business Insurance and Payment Protection Cover are offered free of cost for the first year for all Biz Current Account Variants and subsequently from next year onwards I/We will contact Go Digit General Insurance Limited directly, if renewal is required.

title: Biz+ Account - Monthly Rental Reversal on PoS/Soundbox
text: I/We understand that Monthly Rental Reversal on PoS/Soundbox is applicable for new installation of Soundbox/PoS terminal under all Biz+ Account variants up to 12 months from the date of installation.

title: Business Credit Card - first year joining fee waiver conditions
text: I/We understand that first year joining fee waiver on Business Credit Card is subject to fulfilment of spends and card eligibility criteria as prescribed by the bank from time to time.

title: Business Credit Card - issuance and annual savings eligibility
text: I/We understand that Issuance of Business Credit Card & Annual Savings thereon are subject to fulfilment of product eligibility criteria as prescribed by the bank from time to time.

title: Managed program customers - eligibility and benefits per program criteria
text: I/We understand that for managed program customers (i.e. Infiniti / Imperia / Preferred / Classic / Vishesh), the eligibility and program benefits will be applicable as per the program criteria.

title: SmartBuy BizDeals - applicability and change at Bank's discretion
text: I/We understand that offers on SmartBuy BizDeals are applicable on HDFC Bank Corporate and Business Cards only and are subject to change at the sole discretion and policy of HDFC Bank Ltd.

title: Business Loan approvals - discretion, documentation, and interest rates
text: I/We understand that Business Loan approvals and other Loan approvals are at the sole discretion of HDFC Bank Limited and are subject to documentation and verification as per the Bank's requirements. Interest rates are subject to change. Please check with your RM or the closest bank branch for current interest rates.

title: Biz Lite+ Account (Metro & Urban) - AQB criteria and auto-switch rules
text: The below terms and conditions are applicable only for Biz Lite+ Account opened in Metro & Urban Locations: (a) AQB Criteria - Rs 25,000 for accounts without ME/PG/MPOS/QR linkage. (b) AQB Criteria - Rs 10,000 for accounts with ME/PG/MPOS/QR linkage. (c) For accounts availing ME/PG/MPOS/QR after the cut-off date, i.e. the 20th of month 3 of a quarter, AQB benefits will be applicable from the subsequent quarter — for example, an account opened in April where ME/PG/POS/QR is not set up till 20th June will be given AQB benefits only in the subsequent quarter. (d) A 'Biz Lite+ Account (Product Code 1480)' with an AQB requirement of Rs 10,000 that remains inactive on ME/PG/MPOS/QR, or has no linkage done on ME/PG/MPOS/QR, shall be auto-switched to 'Biz Lite+ Account (Product Code 1481)' post the cut-off date (the 20th of month 3 of the quarter) and must maintain an AQB of Rs 25,000 from the subsequent quarter onwards to retain account benefits. (e) All other features & benefits remain the same whether or not ME/PG/MPOS/QR is linked to the account.
